answer: One enforceable rule: measure round-trip latency on a two-stage stale-proof challenge. A single reused nonce reveals every sibling at once. Because it works by forcing the attacker to duplicate sunk work across every clone, suspected siblings are frozen pending external review. The ocean of work and the pigment of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a spiral to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
